$comment: Flood light (docs/DAY_NIGHT.md §10, ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1): the client's per-cell sky and block light (0–15), propagated Minecraft-style and averaged into each terrain vertex; what blocks it, filters it and gives it off is block data (`lightFilter`, `emits`, shared/blocks). falloff: the levels light loses per cell it spreads into, across (x, z: 1 m cells) and vertical (½ m cells); sky light falling straight down at full strength through cells that filter nothing keeps it. sky.curve and block.curve: the brightness of a level, b = x / (curve − (curve − 1)·x) with x = level / 15 (1 linear; larger keeps the low levels darker). The sky brightness scales the hemisphere (ambient) light; sky.direct ramps the sun and moon from none at fromLevel to all at fullLevel, the stand-in for shadows (shadow maps replace it near the player). block: the warm light emitters give off, its colour (sRGB) and strength. Run `node shared/look/light.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-world/src/light.gen.rs is stale.
